=== /etc/open-linux-router/rendered/dhcp/dnsmasq.conf (mode 0644, reloadable=false)
# dnsmasq configuration for the olr dhcp module
#
# Generated by open-linux-router from
#   /etc/open-linux-router/dhcp.json
# Do not edit: this file is rewritten on every apply and your changes will be
# lost. Use `olr dhcp set`, or the extra_dnsmasq_conf field for settings
# olr does not model.

# DHCP only. DNS belongs to the dns module and unbound (design.md §4.2), and
# without port=0 this dnsmasq would silently become a second resolver on the
# box, answering queries nobody configured it to answer.
port=0

# Bind only the interfaces that have a pool, so another DHCP or DNS server on
# this machine keeps its own sockets (design.md §3.4). bind-dynamic and not
# bind-interfaces: both allow a second instance, but bind-interfaces binds only
# what exists at startup, and a router creates bridges and VLANs after boot.
bind-dynamic
except-interface=lo

dhcp-leasefile=/var/lib/open-linux-router/dhcp/leases
pid-file=/run/olr/dhcp/dhcp.pid

# Reservations and per-pool options live in directories because dnsmasq re-reads
# those on SIGHUP but never re-reads this file. That is what makes adding a
# reservation a reload rather than a restart.
dhcp-hostsdir=/etc/open-linux-router/rendered/dhcp/hosts.d
dhcp-optsdir=/etc/open-linux-router/rendered/dhcp/opts.d

# pool: br-lan (192.168.1.1/24)
interface=br-lan
dhcp-range=set:br-lan,192.168.1.100,192.168.1.200,255.255.255.0,21600
# IPv6: advertise the prefix for self-assignment, answer DHCPv6
# information requests for DNS and NTP.
dhcp-range=set:br-lan,::,constructor:br-lan,ra-stateless

# Required for any of the IPv6 ranges above to be advertised.
enable-ra

# --- extra_dnsmasq_conf ---
# Passed through verbatim from the module config (design.md §3.2 rule 5). It is
# revisioned with everything else, which is the point: unusual settings stay
# visible to olr instead of being hand-edited into a file olr does not read.
log-dhcp
dhcp-authoritative
=== /etc/open-linux-router/rendered/dhcp/hosts.d/112233445566.conf (mode 0644, reloadable=true)

=== /etc/open-linux-router/rendered/dhcp/opts.d/br-lan.conf (mode 0644, reloadable=true)
# DHCP options for br-lan
#
# Generated by open-linux-router from
#   /etc/open-linux-router/dhcp.json
# Do not edit: this file is rewritten on every apply and your changes will be
# lost. Use `olr dhcp set`, or the extra_dnsmasq_conf field for settings
# olr does not model.

tag:br-lan,option:router,192.168.1.254
tag:br-lan,option:dns-server,192.168.1.1
tag:br-lan,option6:dns-server,[2001:db8::1]
tag:br-lan,option:domain-name,lan
tag:br-lan,option:ntp-server,192.168.1.1
tag:br-lan,252,http://wpad.lan/wpad.dat
